definition: A ModelInvocation is a single call, by an agent, to an underlying model (typically an LLM) to decide a next action or produce output.
notes: A ModelInvocation always belongs to exactly one AgentRun
A ModelInvocation may fail, succeed, or be canceled
Token usage is only meaningful on the finished predicate
examples: A single chat completion request to an LLM provider
A streaming generation call that produces the agent's next action
counterExamples: A call to an external tool/function (see ToolCall)
